notes.title: So this is Christmas. All the best from the Game Island team!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40160188/f4a3799b1d762a463c111b5135d05925f9005fed.png[/img]

It’s been a busy year for us at Game Island studios, and we are stepping into 2022 with double the strength! Thank you so much for being with us through this game-making journey. Your feedback and appreciation are the main forces that drive us forward. 

We want to wish you all a Merry Christmas, in a family atmosphere, with your favorite people and favorite food. Let the next year be even better than you expect, full of great games to play and exciting things to do, and even more friends to make. 

[h2]All the best from the Game Island crew![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583020/Bunker_Survival/
